content.title: Masters Cut Line: How Many Players Make the Cut At the Masters?
content.text: Apr 10, 2026, 8:04 PM min read (AP Photo/Matt Slocum) The cut at the Masters is different than most other PGA Tour events. The top 50 players and ties after the first two rounds play the weekend. Most PGA Tour events have the top 65 players and ties playing the weekend. Additionally, all players who make the cut at the Masters are part of the prize money payouts. Masters Cut Line In 2026, the cut line was +4, and 54 players made the cut.
